title: ordered-subnet-handshake-and-private-dns-stitching
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: private control plane installs in multi-AZ accounts were intermittently failing during cutover when multiple regions attempted simultaneous subnet handoff and Private Hosted Zone (PHZ) propagation. This PR implements an ordered subnet handshake plus a deterministic private DNS stitching path to avoid race conditions during peering and route propagation. In addition it introduces a small cross-account role-sync helper so peering acceptance and Route53 resolver rules are created in a reproducible order. Design summary: 1) Subnet lifecycle hooks: add a 'handover_sequence' attribute to controlplane_subnet module and a transient lock via DynamoDB to serialize AZ handoff if multiple controlplanes run in parallel. 2) Peering acceptance: add iam role bootstrap and a short-lived S3-backed token to prevent race acceptance across accounts. 3) Private DNS stitching: create explicit resolver rule promotion steps (forwarding -> inbound resolver rule -> conditional PHZ association) with polling and exponential backoff instead of blind parallel associations. 4) Security groups: create an explicit egress-firewall SG that is attached as a managed dependency, and tighten management CIDR on peering ACLs. 5) Helm: small values.yaml change and template to surface the controlplane subnet annotations so downstream installer hooks can observe 'handover_sequence'. Backwards compatibility: all new fields are optional and default to previous semantics (parallel handoff). Existing customers unaffected unless they opt-in. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship as a minor private-installer release, enable ordered handoff via feature flag in 2 pilot customers, monitor resolver association latencies and peering acceptance errors. Rollback: feature flag toggle and reapply old module defaults; explicit cleanup steps included for DynamoDB locks and resolver rules. Testing: unit terraform plan snapshots, integration run in staging with two concurrent installs, end-to-end test asserting no PHZ overlap and route propagation within 3 minutes. Checklist: [x] terraform fmt and validate [x] added unit tests for module logic [x] integration test in staging [x] documented new variables and upgrade notes [x] rollout playbook included

release_notes: Ordered subnet handoff and deterministic private DNS stitching to prevent race conditions during controlplane provisioning; optional feature flag 'ordered_handover' (default true); new DynamoDB lock table and short-lived peering token for cross-account acceptance; tighter SG defaults; helm exposes subnet handover annotation; upgrade playbook included.
